cohort: Pregnant ladies aged 20-40 years with a history of one or more previous caesarean sections and gestational age 37-41 weeks were enrolled.
finding: MRI and USG are highly sensitive and accurate imaging modalities for diagnosing placenta accreta in previous scar patients, showing comparable diagnostic accuracies.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (37-41 weeks gestation), from Oct 2016 to Mar 2017
